title: やってVariable
prompt:
Declare a variable and assign it a value, then print out the value.
Sample Input: 10
Sample Output: 10
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's an example in Python:

```python
# Declare a variable and assign it a value
my_variable = 10

# Print out the value of the variable
print(my_variable)
```

When you run this code, it will declare a variable named `my_variable` and assign it the value 10. Then, it will print out the value of the variable, which will be 10.
